thread:
mia: Heads-up — vendor just pushed H100 shipment ETA to 3 weeks (was 6 days). We need to decide: air-expedite (+18% cost) vs rebalancing eu pool.
raj: How many GPUs affected?
mia: 48 GPUs (12 nodes) for ap-southeast dedicated pool. If we miss, we'll breach throughput SLO for two customers.
eli: Vendor offered air-expedite or a credit note + later sea shipment. Air looks fastest but customs + broker fees could add delays.
lina: Customs HS code for these warranty returns is stuck with forwarder. If we route air we must pre-file to avoid GOTCHA at APAC broker.
mia: Any spare headroom in eu/na we can steal temporarily?
raj: eu has 32 GPUs idle in staging, na has 16 but slower network link to ap-southeast. Transit time to ap-southeast from eu ~72h by air, plus customs clearance.
eli: Suggest: push vendor for courier pre-clearance + pickup, and concurrently prepare node reassign plan to shift 8 eu GPUs into ap-southeast region (soft-patch). That buys us ~2 weeks slack.
lina: We can do soft-patch, but note: KMS keys + VPC peering changes required, and we need change window. Ops estimate ~3 hours per node for migration prep.
mia: Ok — compile migration playbook. Raj, can you confirm freight cost vs air-expedite? We need a $/GPU burn calc.
raj: Quick calc: air-expedite vendor price delta = +18% (~$4.1k/GPU). Shipping+broker from eu (air) ~ $900/GPU + temporary cross-region network egress ~ $120/GPU. Ground sea option much cheaper but too slow.
eli: So total for vendor air-expedite ~ $4.1k/GPU. Rebalance eu->apac (own ops) ~ $1k/GPU + migration ops labor (~$200/GPU). Rebalance looks cheaper and faster if customs pre-clear works.
lina: Also check RMA backlog at our APAC depot — we have 4 units in refurb queue that could be certified early if we waive photo evidence step (risk tradeoff). That would free 4 GPUs next week.
mia: That gets us from 48 to 40 gap -> still short. Plan: (1) push vendor for pre-clear and air-expedite hold as fallback, (2) start rebalancing 8 eu GPUs now, (3) expedite depot refurb for 4 units, (4) communicate SLA risk to customers with mitigation timeline.
eli: Agreed. I'll open negotiation thread with vendor: request formal pre-clear + temporary hold on extra charge if we cancel within 48h.
raj: I'll attach a cost sheet in #finance but quick numbers look like rebalancing is ~75% cheaper.
lina: For migration playbook: add step to rotate KMS keys and update route53 entries, and a rollback plan if peering fails. Also add contact for APAC customs broker: +65 8123 4567.
vendor_ops_bot: RMA update: AWB 842-555-338 — depot hold cleared, current status: IN_TRANSIT to APAC hub, eta 1742697600 (unix).
mia: Thanks bot. I'll draft customer message and migration playbook this afternoon. Ping if vendor confirms pre-clear. :thumbsup:
eli: I'll follow up with vendor now, cc @mia and @lina.
raj: Filing cost approval request once vendor replies.
lina: Filing customs pre-clear request with broker now — will report back in 40m.
mia: Great. Keep this thread as single source for decisions.
